verdict.rationale: Deel exposes a REST API and MCP server that can create contracts (including contractor contracts) and lists tools like listOfContracts, createTimeOffRequest, and calculateEorVersusEntityHiringCosts, suggesting an agent could programmatically manage some hiring workflows. However, no evidence shows an explicit end-to-end 'create employee + compensation + tax setup' API/agent flow — only contractor contract creation is documented in detail. missing for 10: explicit API/MCP tool for full employee (not just contractor) creation, dedicated compensation-setup endpoint, and tax-setup endpoint/tool, plus a documented end-to-end onboarding example.
